claim: An agent was told: find a well-reviewed mechanical keyboard and put it in the cart. Someone watching should believe DemoKit carried out the whole errand on the real Amazon - searched, filtered to four stars and up, opened a product, read the reviews, added it, turned down the protection-plan upsell, and ended on a cart with a real subtotal - and that every screen it showed was Amazon's, not a mock.
_ledger: S0  amazon.com, cold                                          <- where the viewer starts
S1  the search: live suggestions as it types                  <- type
S2  results, hundreds of them                                 <- click the exact-match suggestion
S3  filtered to 4 stars and up, a Clear chip appears          <- click the filter
S4  one keyboard: price, rating, the buy box                  <- click the top result
S5  what buyers actually say                                  <- scroll to reviews
S6  back up to the buy box                                    <- scroll
S7  the protection-plan upsell, the moment most demos hide   <- add to cart
S8  declined; Added to cart, one item                         <- No thanks
S9  the cart, with a real subtotal                            <- open the cart
